sync_active_high_reset: Reset clears q to 0 and ena to 0 (contract default).
Reset only mandates synchronous active-high reset; q and ena values under reset are unspecified/don't-care.
Reset clears q to 0 but leaves ena unspecified.
upper_digit_enables: Combinational same-cycle enable based on current q, with ena[0]=tens, ena[1]=hundreds, ena[2]=thousands (contract default).
Combinational same-cycle enable based on current q, with reversed bit order: ena[2]=tens, ena[1]=hundreds, ena[0]=thousands.
Registered active-high enable visible one cycle after the carry condition is met, with ena[0]=tens, ena[1]=hundreds, ena[2]=thousands.
Registered active-high enable visible one cycle after the carry condition is met, with reversed bit order.
Registered enable from carry: after 9->10 transition ena[0]=1 while q=10, unlike combinational current-q where ena[0]=0 at q=10.
